Fenerbahçe Spor Kulübü, simply known as Fenerbahçe or Fener, is the football branch of the Fenerbahçe Sports Club organisation. Based in Istanbul, the team compete in the Süper Lig, the top division of Turkish football. Founded in 1907, Fenerbahçe is one of Turkey's most successful and widely supported clubs, boasting a record 28 Turkish national championship titles, including victories in the National Division, Turkish Football Championship and the Süper Lig era, of which only 19 league championship titles are counted by the Turkish Football Federation for the awarding of the championship star. The club has also won 10 Turkish Super Cups and 7 Turkish Cups, making them one of the most decorated teams in Turkish football history. Their home matches have been played at the Şükrü Saracoğlu Stadium in the Kadıköy district of Istanbul since 1908.
